slices.focus: Caleb experiences a stress and reflux crisis during Gulf storm watch, leading to supervisor intervention and new boundaries around late-night resident calls
slices.summary: A tropical system lingering in the Gulf triggers severe reflux, early-morning chest tightness, and brittle stress in Caleb. He has been internalizing too many resident callbacks personally until supervisor Sharon intervenes, pushing him to use a shared callback board and cut late-night calls. He creates a morning anti-escalation script and sets a no-calls-after-dinner boundary.
open_loops: Lock in no-calls-after-dinner rule with narrow deadline exception
Use shared callback board daily instead of letting side notes pile up
Track early-morning wakeups, dinner cutoff adherence, and board currency for 2 weeks
